label: Disclaimer
title: Disclaimer
summary: Use a Disclaimer for one short legal line under an action, such as who provides a payment service.
corePrinciple: Small print that says who stands behind the action, in one or two lines.

anatomy.title: Small print in a narrow column
anatomy.description: One string of 10 px grey text, centred line by line in a column up to 281 px wide. Copy that doesn’t name Jio Payments Bank gets the bank’s name on a second line.
blocks: One string; a line break is the only formatting it takes.
At most 281 px wide; the text wraps there and centres.
specimen: Payment and UPI services are provided by Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.

anatomy.note: One string; a line break is the only formatting it takes.

configuration.title: The copy is the only choice
configuration.description: Disclaimer has no variants, icon, or size. Write the copy for the screen; without it, the package shows a generic Jio Payments Bank line. Copy that doesn’t name the bank gets “Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.” on a line below.
blocks: A line break before the bank’s name keeps it on one line, as in Figma.
Say what continuing means; the package adds the bank’s name below.
Without copy it shows “All financial services…”, which differs from Figma.
specimen: Payment and UPI services are provided by Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.
By continuing you agree to the terms for this payment. Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.
All financial services are provided by Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.

states.title: Static text, no states
states.description: Disclaimer isn’t interactive: it has no hover, pressed, focus, or disabled style, and Tab skips it. Inside a full-screen modal footer, the modal turns it light grey to suit its dark surface.

sizing.title: Up to 281 px wide, 12 px a line
sizing.description: The column is 281 px wide, or as wide as a narrower host, and the text centres inside it. Each line adds 12 px. It centres in any vertical stack, including one that stretches its children.
blocks: “Terms apply.” takes two lines: the package adds the bank’s name below it.
At 281 px this copy takes five lines, 60 px of small print.

content.title: Say who provides it, in a sentence
content.description: Name the provider or the condition in one or two short sentences. Put the full terms on their own page and add a Link below; the copy can’t hold links or bold text.
specimen: By continuing you agree to the terms for this payment. Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.

inContext.title: Under a payment action
inContext.description: A payment footer holds the Pay button and, below it, the provider line. The footer passes its modes to both; the screen handles the payment.
specimen: Payment and UPI services are provided by Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.

sources.title: Use the public Disclaimer contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (23 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Disclaimer is one 281 × 24 component with no properties, and the package matches its type and width; their default copy differs. The package adds “Jio Payments Bank Pvt. Ltd.” on a second line to copy that doesn’t name the bank. The copy is a single string: links and formatting are not supported. Screen readers read the copy and that line as one label, or accessibilityLabel when it’s set. This page shows Light only.
